requirements.text: The System shall operate in an Open Mode, allowing authorized customers read-only access to requested Data Products.
The System shall operate in a Degraded System Mode, generating a subset of products based on priority and resource availability.
The System shall notify customers when the NPOESS Ground System enters or leaves a Degraded Operations Mode.
The System shall operate in a Restricted Access Mode, limiting data access to users meeting specific authorization criteria.
The System shall notify authorized users when they receive restricted access data.
The System shall define Data Products for Ingest.
The System shall integrate System Elements including Scientific Algorithms, Product Tailoring Tools, and Data Format Translation Tools.
The System shall support functional and performance testing of system elements without impacting operational product generation.
The System shall maintain at least 30 days of Ingest history.
The System shall control the execution of Scientific Algorithms.
The System shall generate Data Products.
The System shall allow authorized users to adjust Product Generation priorities.
The System shall render Platte Carre, Mercator, and Polar Stereographic projections.
The System shall aggregate Data Products up to one orbit.
The System shall produce time-averaged Data Products.
The System shall generate NOAA-Unique and Tailored Data Products with Government-specified grid spacing.
The System shall reformat Data Products into BUFR, GRIB2, GeoTIFF, HDF5, and netCDF formats.
The System shall compress Data Products using GZIP, ZIP, RICE, JPEG, and MPEG algorithms.
The System shall generate Data Products within the maximum user-specified shelf-life.
The System shall provide an online capability for registered users to request subscriptions to Data Products.
The System shall provide an online capability for the Government to approve subscription requests.
The System shall distribute NOAA-Unique Data Products to the CLASS Long-Term Archive.
The System shall provide a list of files distributed to CLASS and receive electronic delivery acknowledgments.
The System shall deliver NDE Data Products to registered user computer systems.
The System shall notify registered users of order status and system status.
The System shall ensure NDE information is accessible only to authorized users.
The System shall register users to control access to System Elements and Data Products.
The System shall report performance related to resource utilization, communications, product latencies, and hardware.
The System shall provide automatic failover to re-create a fully functioning configuration from a failed one.
The System shall monitor the integrity of data received from external sources.
The System shall allow authorized users to define and execute data input integrity checks.
The System shall make products available for distribution according to customer-specified latencies.
The System shall monitor, record, and report performance statistics, retaining logs for at least 90 days.
The System shall generate custom reports from data collected during receipt, processing, and distribution.
The System shall receive data and products from IDPS, including xDRs, SARSAT telemetry, and A-DCS data.
The System shall provide an operator console to submit subscriptions and Ad Hoc requests to the IDPS.
The System shall receive Data Delivery Reports from the IDPS.
The System shall receive Ancillary Data Products from the ESPC.
The System shall ingest and process archived data.
The System shall request and receive Data Products from CLASS and send delivery receipts.
The System shall interface with the NPOESS and ESPC trouble ticketing systems.
The System shall execute tasks according to a schedule or event-driven triggers.
The System shall adjust the priorities of scheduled and event-driven tasks.
The System shall validate metadata against FGDC standards.
The System shall store product quality information in product metadata.
The System shall retain NOAA-Unique Data Products for a configurable period up to 96 hours.
The System shall accept technology updates without downtime.
The System shall be scalable to add capacity without infrastructure redesign.
The System shall comply with ESPC security procedures and policies.
The System shall generate and restore from automated system backups.
The System shall protect data integrity from human errors, transmission errors, software bugs, hardware malfunctions, and natural disasters.
The System shall be accessible only with Government authorization.
The System shall reuse existing hardware and software where practical and approved.
The System shall use COTS and Open Source software where practical and approved.
The System shall design elements for reuse in other satellite data processing applications.
The System shall invoke Scientific Algorithms as objects.
The System shall provide operator logs to track events and activities, with search and sort capabilities.
The System shall provide procedures to quiesce and restart the system with minimal service interruption.
The System shall monitor and report on input and output metadata quality against configurable thresholds.
The System shall allow operators to forward NDE System Elements to CLASS for permanent archive.
The NDE Ingest, Product Generation, Distribution, and Operations Monitoring capabilities shall not be interrupted for more than 2 hours in any 24-hour period or 4 hours in any 30-day period.
The Development and Maintenance Environment shall be available to at least 25 developers 85% of the time during business hours.
The System shall access IDPS data within 10 seconds of notification.
The System shall deliver SARSAT and A-DCS telemetry/data to the USMCC/GPC within 1 minute of receipt.
The System shall support 4TB/day input and 8TB/day output for NPP, and 8TB/day input and 16TB/day output for NPOESS-C1/C2.
The System shall execute 99% of scheduled and event-driven tasks in any 30-day period.
The System shall have the capacity to store 4 Terabytes of data for testing purposes.
The System shall be compliant with the OMB Federal Enterprise Architecture.
